create_output_graph: create an OutputGraph instance to wrap FX graph outputs for a frame being processed by the instruction translator
build_subgraph_tracer: build a SubgraphTracer to hold an FX graph being traced with nested support for higher-order operators
compile_subgraph: compile the current subgraph and generate bytecode instructions to continue execution in user code
checkpoint_graph_state: checkpoint the current OutputGraphState by copying input sources, tracked fakes, guards, and side effects
restore_graph_state: restore a previously checkpointed OutputGraphState and remove any nodes added after the checkpoint
